package.name: ur_uncertain_assembly_sampling
package.description: Uncertain assembly sampling for the UR10e. Repeatedly executes a chunk of the ideal assembly trajectory (held object w.r.t. target object), resampled to a fixed spatial resolution and perturbed with a per-trial uniform bias plus per-waypoint uniform noise, then disassembles along the ideal reverse path. Logs tool0 + held-object poses and F/T (in tool0 and held frames) to a single CSV, flushed per trial. Subclasses ur_kinematic_assembly_demo.
